## Checklist

- [ ] Branch follows naming convention (`feature/STU-N-*`, `fix/STU-N-*`, `chore/STU-N-*`)

- [ ] Formatting applied (`npm run format`)
- [ ] Screenshots attached (if UI change)
- [ ] No secrets or credentials committed
